chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
There is no usury between us and the people with whom we are at war; we take from them, but we do not give to them.

key_terms.حَرْبِنَا: our war; those in a state of war with the Muslim community
key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.رِبًا: usury or interest in financial dealings

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on riba between Muslims and enemy combatants at war?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding riba in dealings with hostile enemies in a state of war. It presents a distinction in financial transactions with such parties, specifying that riba may be taken from them but not given to them.
